thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P1 alert — elevated 5xx and TLS handshake failures at edge gateways (multiple regions). Paging on-call (emma).

emma: acked, I'm on it. seeing large spike in gateway 525/524 and TLS handshake failures in logs.

emma: quick check — Grafana shows spike starting 2026-03-14T02:07Z, error_rate ~ 18% across edge-proxy pool us-west-2.

noah: jumping in. any recent cert rotations or deploys?

emma: deploy-bot shows a cert rotation job completed ~02:05Z that pushed new certs to edge-proxy config.

deploy-bot: automation: cert-rotation-job (rotation-2026-03-14) completed successfully to edge-proxy pool, rolled to 60% of nodes.

emma: logs look like lots of `ssl handshake failure` and `tls: handshake failure` and client errors `alert handshake failure`. Example from edge-proxy-7: 
```
2026-03-14T02:08:12Z edge-proxy-7 ERROR tls: client handshake error: remote error: tls: bad certificate
2026-03-14T02:08:12Z edge-proxy-7 ERROR upstream: 525 backend handshake failed
```

sam: can we test the cert chain from the inside? try openssl s_client to the gateway ip that has the new cert.

emma: running `openssl s_client -connect 10.12.7.22:443 -showcerts -servername gateway.redwood.test` output: 
```
---
Certificate chain
 0 s:/CN=gateway.redwood.test
   i:/C=US/O=ExampleCA
-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----
...
-----END CERTIFICATE-----
---
Server certificate
subject=/CN=gateway.redwood.test
issuer=/C=US/O=ExampleCA
---
No client certificate CA names sent
---
SSL handshake has read 1200 bytes and written 450 bytes
verify error:num=20:unable to get local issuer certificate
---
```

emma: verify error looks like missing intermediate. also `No client certificate CA names sent` is suspicious when mTLS is enforced.

noah: that verify error explains client failures — many clients (and other internal services) verify chain and fail when intermediate not present. did rotation strip intermediate from secret?

dinesh: checking k8s secrets: `kubectl -n infra get secret edge-tls -o yaml` shows `tls.crt` blob looks like the leaf cert only (no intermediate concatenated). previous secret had leaf + intermediate chain.

sam: ok this fits. rotation step appears to have updated secret with only leaf cert. We need immediate mitigation: 1) roll back cert on affected nodes to previous secret, OR 2) push updated secret with full chain.

emma: for quick mitigation, suggestion: enable one-way TLS fallback for edge-proxy pool so clients that don't require mTLS are accepted, and route mTLS traffic to a node group with old certs. but that's risky for truly mTLS-only customers.

olivia: support here — which customers impacted? We should prepare communication.

emma: initial impact: ~14 customers show increased errors (internal tracking id INC-194999). CS will need a status update.

sam: action plan now:
- block rotation job (stop further rollout)
- create temp secret that concatenates leaf + intermediate and push to affected clusters
- restart edge-proxy pods gracefully to pick up cert
- monitor 5xx and TLS handshake metric
- prepare customer note draft (olivia)

emma: executing: `kubectl -n infra create secret tls edge-tls --cert=fullchain.pem --key=privkey.pem --dry-run=client -o yaml | kubectl apply -f -`

sam: applied fullchain to cluster us-west-2; performing rolling restart for edge-proxy pool with `kubectl rollout restart deployment/edge-proxy -n infra --selector=pool=us-west-2`

noah: to be safe, I've paused the cert rotation workflow in CI: `rotation-job: paused` so it won't hit other regions.

deploy-bot: automation: rotation-job paused by noah.

emma: metrics update: 02:16Z 5xx rate decreased from 18% -> 6% in us-west-2 after restart. TLS handshake errors trending down.

olivia: drafting customer-facing blurb: "We experienced intermittent TLS handshake failures starting 02:07Z due to an automated certificate rotation that omitted the intermediate CA chain. Mitigation applied; traffic restored at ~02:17Z. We are investigating root cause and will follow up with postmortem."

dinesh: digging root cause: rotation script concatenation step failed when intermediate cert path was empty in the rotation artifact. raising PR to add validation and unit test.

sam: handoff: I'm taking over the incident for next 2 hours to verify other regions and finalize rollback and postmortem notes. @emma handing off.

emma: thanks, @sam — good handoff. last check: make sure mTLS customers verified. @olivia can you confirm CS pinged top 10 impacted customers?

olivia: yes, CS outreach initiated, 6 customers acknowledged, two asked for logs — providing request id ranges.

sam: follow-ups:
- audit rotation pipeline history and artifact storage for missing intermediate
- add pre-deploy validation to rotation job to check that fullchain.pem contains more than one cert
- schedule postmortem and include mitigation playbook update (fast rollback vs fallback)

noah: also adding a monitoring alert for cert chain length so future rotations with missing intermediates trigger a job failure.

deploy-bot: incident-bot: incident status changed to "mitigated" by sam at 2026-03-14T02:25Z.

sam: confirmed stabilization. 5xx back to baseline, handshake failures resolved. will keep monitoring and open postmortem ticket.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident mitigated — P1 downgraded. Create postmortem (INC-194999).

emma: good job everyone.

olivia: I'll send a short customer update and link to the postmortem when ready.

sam: handing back to oncall rotation to standby: @emma you are now back on-call.

emma: back oncall, thanks. documenting timeline and links to logs in INC-194999.

incident-bot: thread closed for active paging. Remember to attach rollout artifacts and CI logs to the postmortem.
